policy.settlement: explicit close invoked by external experimental count/amount threshold policy
policy.productionBehavior: Current product/coordinator supports explicit final drain/settle; no automatic threshold watcher.
policy.channelReuse: Each closed channel stays finalized. Every later batch has a distinct fixture identity.

cohorts.storage: actualMemoryPaymentStore and actualSQLitePaymentStore per closed channel

accounting.unit: offline fixture base units; no token value or transfers

limitations: This measures local fixture state-machine work and cannot establish Solana, provider or production throughput.
Native transport outcomes and signature-shaped strings are inert mocks, not actual Ed25519 signatures or chain receipts.
Accepted charges are explicitly injected fixtures after real Exchange auctions; browser receipt authentication is not performed.
Large stress cohort checkpoints finalized channel snapshots, not every voucher transition. The separate durable cohort uses actual SQLitePaymentStore for every adapter transition.
Threshold scheduling is external experimental policy; the committed paid runner settles only through explicit drain/settle.
Fixtures use sandbox envelope internally; no sandbox, Devnet or mainnet endpoint is contacted.
The 100k+ fixture count is separate from the approved paid run and does not enlarge its bounds.
